metadata.label: Radiant Core
metadata.description: White-gold breathing core with magenta atmosphere and a horizontal optical flare.

controlDescriptions.breath: Depth of slow breathing driven by the Lux scene clock.
controlDescriptions.brightness: Linear light strength; values above one intentionally produce an exposed center.
controlDescriptions.flare: Strength of the thin horizontal flare through the core.
controlDescriptions.haze: Amount of broad magenta atmosphere behind the strands.
controlDescriptions.radius: Radius of the central light in canvas-height units.

metadata.label: Luminous Dust
metadata.description: Sparse seeded golden dust with scene-clock drift and soft additive sprites.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Additive golden light strength; zero removes dust light.
controlDescriptions.count: Visible particles out of a fixed pool of 96; identities do not shuffle.
controlDescriptions.drift: Slow upward flow and lateral sway; zero freezes dust motion and twinkle.
controlDescriptions.size: Base sprite diameter in canvas-height units. Supports stable per-instance variation.

metadata.label: Neon Cables & Ribbons
metadata.description: Mesh-strip path renderer with luminous filaments, traveling pulses, glossy ribbons, glass-style cables and attached metallic collars.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Up to 16 paths with at most 97 points per path.

controlDescriptions.brightness: Strength of strand color and highlights; zero leaves the background untouched.
controlDescriptions.cables: Paths after the ribbons rendered as glass-style strips, without physical refraction.
controlDescriptions.collars: Visibility of two metallic collars on each glass-style cable.
controlDescriptions.palette: Shifts alternating strands toward cyan or magenta.
controlDescriptions.pulseSpeed: Signed circuits per second. Zero freezes each pulse at its phase.
controlDescriptions.pulseStrength: Extra energy in traveling packets; zero gives steady strands.
controlDescriptions.pulseWidth: Fraction of the route illuminated by each traveling packet.
controlDescriptions.ribbonWidth: Ribbon width as a multiple of the incoming path width.
controlDescriptions.ribbons: First paths rendered as broad dark glossy ribbons. Remaining paths become cables or neon.

metadata.label: Looping Spline Paths
metadata.description: Persistent closed figure-eight strands around a central opening; sampled paths2d for independent renderers.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Up to sixteen closed paths, 97 points each.

controlDescriptions.count: Number of persistent strands. Existing identities stay stable as more are added.
controlDescriptions.motion: Slow analytic deformation; zero freezes the routes.
controlDescriptions.seed: Chooses a repeatable arrangement of looping strands.
controlDescriptions.spread: Scales the knot around its central opening.
controlDescriptions.width: Full base width in canvas-height units; renderer style scales this width.
